entries.title: Customer portal frontend dashboard.
entries.notes: Route-backed Capell fixture showing the authenticated customer dashboard with profile, billing, documents, events, and support summary cards.
entries.useCase: A signed-in customer opens one private hub for account details and package-contributed self-service items.

entries.title: Customer portal preferences and support form.
entries.notes: Route-backed Capell fixture showing schema-driven preferences beside the encrypted support-request form.
entries.useCase: A customer updates communication preferences and submits a support request without leaving the portal.

entries.title: Customer portal support triage admin list.
entries.notes: Route-backed Capell admin fixture showing site-scoped support requests with status and priority indicators.
entries.useCase: Staff triage customer support requests from the Capell admin panel.

entries.title: Customer portal support triage edit screen.
entries.notes: Route-backed Capell admin fixture showing support request detail, encrypted context, status, and priority workflow controls.
entries.useCase: Staff review a customer request and update triage workflow fields.
